title_zh: 地铁艺术季·萌漫奇遇——徐州地铁动漫艺术展
title_en: Running Into ACG: Xuzhou Metro Youth Art Exhibition
content_zh: 地铁艺术季·萌漫奇遇——徐州地铁动漫艺术展
2600年建城史的徐州遇上灵动鲜活的动漫，呼啸的地铁串联起次元与现实的边界。作为徐州地铁艺术季的重要组成部分，这场兼具文化温度与趣味创意的展览将动漫的魅力融入公共空间，从经典作品的持久记忆，到破圈IP的民族美学觉醒，再到奇趣内心的原创表达，配合主题文化角，将交通枢纽转化为动态艺术空间，让通勤的旅客在匆忙中邂逅童真与美好，搭建起贴近市民、激发创意的青春美育平台。
content_en: Running Into ACG: Xuzhou Metro Youth Art Exhibition

The 2,600-year history of Xuzhou meets vibrant ACG art as the whirring metro bridges the boundaries between virtuality and reality. As a key component of the Xuzhou Metro Art Season, this exhibition, brimming with cultural warmth and playful creativity, infuses public spaces with the allure of ACG. From enduring memories of classic works to the national aesthetic awakening of trending anime IPs, and on to whimsical original expressions of inner worlds, the exhibition, with extension programmes, transforms the transport hub into dynamic art space, forming encounters between passengers and childlike wonders, and establishing a vibrant platform for aesthetic education that connects with citizens and sparks creativity.
